content.overview: A perpetual injunction prevents breach of an obligation in the plaintiff's favour, including property rights as enacted.
content.study: Temporary injunctions are CPC Order XXXIX. Final injunctions are SRA 38 and 39. Mandatory injunction is 39. An injunction that amounts to specific performance of a 14 contract will fail.
